props.name: density

props.name: labelBehavior
props.description: Whether text labels are visually shown.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual form of the tab strip. `line` is the default underlined strip; `pill` is the register's glass tab bar — stacked icon-over-label slots in a full-radius glass capsule. `pill` is horizontal-only and never collapses into the overflow picker.

props.name: aria-label

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element labeling the tab list. Required when aria-label is not provided.
